question: Does the 404 on nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free depend on the caller IP? Re-probe it from a second IP and compare with the gateway's published 429 at 200 requests per hour per IP.
why: binding_note, chaining and reliability_note attribute the 404 to a per-IP tier, but the published per-IP limit answers HTTP 429 and the probed 404 body nests an upstream provider error ('Not found for account'), so the per-IP attribution is unverified
